notes: This is a niche submarket. The exact-match seed terms (framing contractor insurance, framing subcontractor insurance) have very low volume (10-20/mo) because searchers use broader category terms. Strategy: rank on broader terms (contractor GL, subcontractor insurance, construction insurance) with framing-specific content, and capture long-tail via service/blog pages. All volume figures are US monthly averages from DataForSEO / Google Ads. null volume = sub-10 or not indexed by Google Ads.
